title: Boundaries of the Land

questions.question: What is the western boundary of the promised land?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:6 (ESV): "For the western boundary, you shall have the Great Sea and its coast."

questions.question: Who was appointed to divide the land?
options: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun
questions.correctAnswer: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:17 (ESV): "Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun."

questions.question: How many chielfs from each tribe were to assist?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:18 (ESV): "You shall take one chief from every tribe to divide the land..."

questions.question: The southern boundary starts from where?
options: Wilderness of Zin along the side of Edom
questions.correctAnswer: Wilderness of Zin along the side of Edom
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:3 (ESV): "Your south side shall be from the wilderness of Zin along the side of Edom..."

questions.question: Who was the chief from the tribe of Judah?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:19 (ESV): "For the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh."

questions.question: What is the eastern boundary?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:12 (ESV): "And the boundary shall go down to the Jordan..."

questions.question: The northern boundary extends to which mountain?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:7 (ESV): "From the Great Sea you shall mark out your line to Mount Hor." (Different from where Aaron died).

questions.question: Which tribes had already received their inheritance?
options: Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:14 (ESV): "For the tribe of the people of Reuben... Gad... Manasseh have received their inheritance."

questions.question: What sea is mentioned on the eastern border (Sea of Chinnereth)?
questions.explanation: Chinnereth is the OT name for Galilee.

questions.question: Who was the chief from Simeon?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:20 (ESV): "Of the tribe of the people of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud."

questions.question: Who was the chief from Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:21 (ESV): "Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad..."

questions.question: Who was the chief from Dan?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:22 (ESV): "Of the tribe of the people of Dan a chief, Bukki..."

questions.question: For Joseph, whose sons were listed?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:23 (ESV): "Of the sons of Joseph..." lists both.

questions.question: What is the "Salt Sea"?
questions.explanation: Numbers 34:3 references "end at the Salt Sea" (southern border).

questions.question: Total number of men Moses named to divide the land (besides Eleazar and Joshua)?
questions.explanation: Counting the names lists one for each of the remaining tribes West of Jordan.

key_verse_text: Command the people of Israel, and say to them, 'When you enter the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance...)'
